articles.title: Once-Weekly Ribupatide for Weight Loss in Adults in China With Overweight or Obesity: The GEMINI-1 Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Zhao L, Chen Y, Cheng Z, Zhu D, Li Q, Cai H, Hui Y, Wang Q, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Obesity is a major health problem in China; more pharmacotherapy choices for long-term weight management are needed.
abstract.textZh: 肥胖是中國的一個主要健康問題；需要有更多用於長期體重管理的藥物治療選擇。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of once-weekly subcutaneous ribupatide, a dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide/glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist, for weight loss in adults in China with overweight or obesity without diabetes.
abstract.textZh: 評估每週一次皮下注射 ribupatide（一種雙葡萄糖依賴性胰高血糖素原多肽／胰高血糖素樣肽-1 受體激動劑）對中國過重或肥胖且無糖尿病的成人減重的療效和安全性。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: This multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 clinical trial was conducted at 55 sites in China. From May to June 2024, adults without diabetes who had a body mass index of 28 or greater or 24 or greater with at least 1 weight-related comorbidity were enrolled, with final follow-up on June 20, 2025.
abstract.textZh: 這項多中心、隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照的第 3 期臨床試驗在中國的 55 個試驗中心進行。2024 年 5 月至 6 月期間，招募了無糖尿病且身體質量指數 (BMI) 大於或等於 28，或 BMI 大於或等於 24 且至少有一種與體重相關的合併症的成年人，最後一次追蹤時間為 2025 年 6 月 20 日。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Participants were randomized to receive once-weekly subcutaneous ribupatide (target doses of 2 mg, 4 mg, or 6 mg) or matching placebo for 48 weeks, with dose escalation for up to 20 weeks and concomitant lifestyle intervention.
abstract.textZh: 參與者被隨機分配接受每週一次皮下注射 ribupatide（目標劑量為 2 毫克、4 毫克或 6 毫克）或相應的安慰劑，為期 48 週，劑量遞增最長可達 20 週，並同時進行生活方式干預。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was change in body weight from baseline to week 48, including percent change in body weight and the percentage of participants achieving at least 5% body weight reduction, analyzed under the treatment policy estimand.
abstract.textZh: 主要療效指標是從基線到第 48 週的體重變化，包括體重變化百分比和達到至少 5% 體重減輕的參與者百分比，根據治療政策估計值進行分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 567 randomized participants (309 [54.5%] female; mean [SD] age was 34.4 [8.4] years, body weight was 93.0 [17.3] kg, and body mass index was 33.3 [4.5]), 514 (90.7%) completed the 48-week treatment period. Least-squares mean percentage changes in body weight at week 48 were -10.7%, -16.4%, and -17.7% with ribupatide 2, 4, and 6 mg, respectively, vs -1.4% with placebo. At week 48, the placebo-adjusted differences in percentage change in body weight were -9.3 (95% CI, -11.4 to -7.3) percentage points with ribupatide 2 mg, -15.0 (95% CI, -17.1 to -12.9) percentage points with ribupatide 4 mg, and -16.3 (95% CI, -18.4 to -14.2) percentage points with ribupatide 6 mg (P < .001 for all). For at least 5% body weight reduction at week 48, the multiply imputed response rates were 68.1% (95% CI, 59.9% to 75.3%) for ribupatide 2 mg (97 of 142), 88.0% (95% CI, 81.3% to 92.6%) for ribupatide 4 mg (124 of 141), 85.7% (95% CI, 78.6% to 90.7%) with ribupatide 6 mg (121 of 141), and 16.0% (95% CI, 10.8% to 23.1%) with placebo (23 of 143). Placebo-adjusted differences for ribupatide 2, 4, and 6 mg were 52.0 (95% CI, 42.2 to 61.9), 72.0 (95% CI, 63.7 to 80.2), and 69.7 (95% CI, 61.1 to 78.3) percentage points, respectively (all P < .001). The most frequent treatment-emergent adverse events with ribupatide were gastrointestinal events, occurring in 47.9%, 58.2%, and 63.1% of participants receiving ribupatide 2 mg, 4 mg, and 6 mg, respectively, compared with 23.1% receiving placebo; most were mild to moderate in severity and few participants (0.7%) permanently discontinued study treatment because of adverse events.
abstract.textZh: 在 567 名隨機分組的參與者中（309 名 [54.5%] 為女性；平均 [標準差] 年齡為 34.4 [8.4] 歲，體重為 93.0 [17.3] 公斤，身體質量指數為 33.3 [4.5]），有 514 名 (90.7%) 完成了 48 週的治療期。在第 48 週時，使用 2、4 和 6 毫克 ribupatide 的體重變化最小平方法平均百分比分別為 -10.7%、-16.4% 和 -17.7%，而使用安慰劑的體重變化為 -1.4%。在第 48 週時，經安慰劑調整後的體重變化百分比差異分別為：使用 2 mg ribupatide 時為 -9.3（95% CI，-11.4 至 -7.3）個百分點；使用 4 mg ribupatide 時為 -15.0（95% CI，-17.1 至 -12.9）個百分點；使用 6 mg ribupatide 時為 -16.3（95% CI，-18.4 至 -14.2）個百分點（所有 P 值均 < .001）。在第 48 週時，體重至少減輕 5% 的多重填補反應率分別為：ribupatide 2 mg 組 68.1% (95% CI, 59.9% 至 75.3%) (142 人中有 97 人)；ribupatide 4 mg 組 88.0% (95% CI, 81.3% 至 92.6%) (141 人中有 124 人)；ribupatide 6 mg 組 85.7% (95% CI, 78.6% 至 90.7%) (141 人中有 121 人)；安慰劑組 16.0% (95% CI, 10.8% 至 23.1%) (143 人中有 23 人)。針對安慰劑調整後的差異，ribupatide 2、4 和 6 mg 分別為 52.0（95% CI，42.2 至 61.9）、72.0（95% CI，63.7 至 80.2）和 69.7（95% CI，61.1 至 78.3）個百分點（均為 P < 0.001）。使用 ribupatide 時最常見的治療中出現的不良事件是胃腸道事件，分別發生在 47.9%、58.2% 和 63.1% 的參與者身上，這些參與者分別接受了 2 mg、4 mg 和 6 mg 的 ribupatide，而接受安慰劑的參與者中，發生率為 23.1%。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Among adults in China with overweight or obesity without diabetes, once-weekly subcutaneous ribupatide resulted in significantly greater weight loss at 48 weeks. Gastrointestinal adverse events were the most frequent tolerability findings.
abstract.textZh: 在中國的超重或肥胖且無糖尿病的成人中，每週一次皮下注射 ribupatide 在 48 週時導致體重減輕顯著增加。胃腸道不良事件是最常見的耐受性發現。

articles.title: Tirzepatide in Adolescents With Obesity: The SURMOUNT-ADOLESCENTS Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Kelly AS, Pamidipati KC, Rachmiel M, Srivastava G, Hsia DS, Fox CK, Fortes E, McLeod L, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Information on the effects of tirzepatide, a once-weekly glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist approved for obesity management in adults with obesity, remains limited in adolescents.
abstract.textZh: 替西帕肽是一種每週一次的葡萄糖依賴性胰高血糖素原多肽和胰高血糖素樣肽-1 受體促效劑，已獲准用於肥胖成人患者的肥胖症管理，但關於其對青少年的影響的資訊仍然有限。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of once-weekly tirzepatide in adolescents with obesity or overweight with at least 1 obesity-related complication.
abstract.textZh: 評估每週一次使用 Tirzepatide 治療患有肥胖或超重且至少有一種與肥胖相關併發症的青少年患者的療效和安全性。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: This phase 3, randomized, double-blind, 72-week clinical trial was conducted at 31 medical research centers and hospitals in Canada, the Czech Republic, Israel, Italy, Poland, and the US from October 16, 2023, to June 2, 2026, among adolescents aged 12 years to younger than 18 years with obesity or overweight with at least 1 obesity-related complication.
abstract.textZh: 這項第 3 期、隨機、雙盲、為期 72 週的臨床試驗於 2023 年 10 月 16 日至 2026 年 6 月 2 日期間，在加拿大、捷克、以色列、義大利、波蘭、以及美國的 31 家醫學研究中心和醫院進行，對象為 2023 年 10 月 16 日至 2026 年 6 月 2 日期間，年齡介於 12 歲至未滿 18 歲、患有肥胖或超重且至少有一種肥胖相關併發症的青少年。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Participants were randomized 2:1 to receive once-weekly subcutaneous tirzepatide, escalated to a maximum tolerated dose (5, 10, or 15 mg), or placebo for 72 weeks, in addition to healthy lifestyle intervention.
abstract.textZh: 除了健康生活方式的干預措施外，參與者以 2:1 的比例隨機分配，接受為期 72 週的每週一次皮下注射替西帕肽，劑量逐步增加至最大耐受劑量（5、10 或 15 毫克），或安慰劑。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary end point was percent change in body mass index (BMI; calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared) from baseline to week 72. Key secondary end points included percentages of participants achieving BMI reductions of at least 5%, at least 10%, at least 15%, and at least 20%; changes in BMI SD score; BMI expressed as a percentage of the 95th percentile; and body weight, waist circumference, and physical functioning from baseline to week 72. Safety outcomes included treatment-emergent adverse events, serious adverse events, and discontinuations due to adverse events.
abstract.textZh: 主要療效指標是從基線到第 72 週身體質量指數 (BMI；計算方式為體重（公斤）除以身高（公尺）的平方）的變化百分比。主要次要療效指標包括：BMI 降低至少 5%、至少 10%、至少 15% 和至少 20% 的參與者百分比；BMI 標準差分數的變化；以第 95 百分位數的百分比表示的 BMI；以及從基線到第 72 週的體重、腰圍和身體機能。安全性結果包括治療中發生的不良事件、嚴重不良事件以及因不良事件而停藥。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 160 participants were randomized to receive tirzepatide (n = 109) or placebo (n = 51). Mean (SD) age at baseline was 14.6 (1.6) years, 99 participants (61.9%) were female, mean body weight was 109.7 kg, and mean BMI was 38.6. At week 72, tirzepatide was associated with 18.5% reduction in BMI, compared with 0.5% increase in BMI with placebo, demonstrating superiority over placebo (estimated treatment difference, -19.0 [95% CI, -23.9 to -14.1] percentage points; P < .001). Of 10 key secondary outcomes, all demonstrated statistically significant differences favoring tirzepatide compared with placebo. Overall, 79.6% of tirzepatide-treated participants achieved BMI reduction of at least 5% compared with 28.5% of participants in the placebo group (risk difference, 51.2 [95% CI, 36.3-66.1] percentage points; P < .001). The most common adverse events with tirzepatide treatment were gastrointestinal (mostly mild to moderate).
abstract.textZh: 共有 160 名參與者被隨機分配接受替西帕肽（n = 109）或安慰劑（n = 51）。基線期的平均（標準差）年齡為 14.6 (1.6) 歲，99 名參與者（61.9%）為女性，平均體重為 109.7 公斤，平均 BMI 為 38.6。在第 72 週時，與安慰劑組 BMI 增加 0.5% 相比，tirzepatide 與 BMI 降低 18.5% 有關，顯示出優於安慰劑的療效（估計治療差異為 -19.0 [95% CI, -23.9 至 -14.1] 個百分點；P < .001）。在 10 項關鍵次要療效指標中，所有指標均顯示出與安慰劑相比，tirzepatide 具有統計學上的顯著差異。整體而言，79.6% 的 tirzepatide 治療參與者 BMI 降低至少 5%，而安慰劑組的參與者則為 28.5%（風險差異為 51.2 [95% CI, 36.3-66.1] 個百分點；P < .001）。使用 Tirzepatide 治療最常見的不良事件是胃腸道不良事件（大多為輕度至中度）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: In adolescents with obesity or overweight with obesity-related complications, tirzepatide, in addition to healthy lifestyle intervention, led to significant reductions in percent change in BMI compared with placebo at 72 weeks.
abstract.textZh: 在有肥胖相關併發症的肥胖或超重青少年中，與安慰劑相比，在第 72 週時，除了健康生活方式干預外，替西帕肽還顯著降低了 BMI 的變化百分比。

articles.title: Empirical tuberculosis treatment in infants living with HIV hospitalised with severe pneumonia in Africa (EMPIRICAL): a multicentre, randomised, open-label, 2 × 2 factorial, controlled superiority trial
articles.authors: Domínguez-Rodríguez S, Tagarro A, Moraleda C, Buck WC, Mujuru H, Chabala C, Mvalo T, Iroh-Tam PY, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Mortality among infants with severe HIV-associated pneumonia remains high globally. The EMPIRICAL trial evaluated whether empirical tuberculosis treatment (eTB-T) improves survival compared with the currently recommended microbiologically and clinically guided strategy.
abstract.textZh: 在全球範圍內，患有嚴重 HIV 相關性肺炎的嬰兒死亡率仍然很高。EMPIRICAL 試驗評估了與目前建議的微生物學和臨床引導策略相比，經驗性結核病治療 (eTB-T) 是否能改善存活率。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This multicentre, open-label, group-sequential designed, 2×2 factorial, randomised, controlled, superiority trial was conducted in 19 hospitals across Côte d'Ivoire, Malawi, Mozambique, Uganda, Zambia, and Zimbabwe. Infants aged 28-365 days admitted with severe HIV-associated pneumonia, without a current tuberculosis diagnosis or contact, were centrally and individually randomly assigned (1:1:1:1) using a secure web-based system stratified by site and severity. A computer-generated block randomisation schedule was used, with fixed blocks of eight allocations (two allocations to each factorial treatment group) within each stratum. Participants received standard of care (SoC) comprising treatment for bacterial (WHO-recommended antibiotics) and Pneumocystis jirovecii (cotrimoxazole and steroids) pneumonia, SoC plus 15 days of oral valganciclovir (16 mg/kg per 12 h), or SoC plus 6 months of tuberculosis treatment (isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol for 2 months, plus isoniazid and rifampicin for 4 subsequent months), or both interventions combined. Here, we report the comparison between the eTB-T (ie, SoC plus tuberculosis treatment and SoC plus oral valganciclovir plus tuberculosis treatment) and non-eTB-T (ie, SoC or SoC plus 15 days of oral valganciclovir) groups. Nasopharyngeal aspirates, stools for Xpert MTB/RIF Ultra testing, and urine for tuberculosis lipoarabinomannan assay were collected at recruitment. In the non-eTB-T groups, tuberculosis treatment was initiated if microbiological results collected at recruitment yielded positive results or if, during follow-up, the treating clinician suspected tuberculosis on clinical grounds, including radiological findings, in accordance with routine clinical practice and guidelines. The primary endpoint was all-cause mortality (at 15 days and 360 days). Survival was estimated using flexible parametric models with covariate-adjusted conditional estimates; missing data were imputed by chained equations. The trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT03915366) and is now complete.
abstract.textZh: 這項多中心、開放標籤、群組順序設計、2×2 因子設計、隨機、對照、優效性試驗在象牙海岸、馬拉威、莫三比克、烏干達、尚比亞和辛巴威的 19 家醫院進行。年齡在 28 至 365 天之間、因罹患嚴重 HIV 相關性肺炎而住院、目前未被診斷為結核病或未曾接觸過結核病患者的嬰兒，透過依據研究中心和嚴重程度分層的安全網路系統，以集中和個別方式隨機分配（1:1:1:1）。採用電腦產生的區塊隨機分配表，每個分層內有固定區塊，包含八個分配（每個因子治療組有兩個分配）。參與者接受標準治療（SoC），包括細菌性肺炎（世界衛生組織推薦的抗生素）和肺囊蟲肺炎（複方新諾明和類固醇）的治療，SoC 加上 15 天的口服 valganciclovir（每 12 小時 16 毫克/公斤），或 SoC 加上 6 個月的結核病治療（異菸肼、利福平、吡嗪醯胺和乙胺丁醇治療 2 個月，加上異菸肼和利福平治療接下來的 4 個月），或兩者合併治療。在此，我們報告了 eTB-T 組（即 SoC 加上結核病治療，以及 SoC 加上口服 valganciclovir 再加上結核病治療）與非 eTB-T 組（即 SoC 或 SoC 加上 15 天的口服 valganciclovir）之間的比較。在招募時收集了鼻咽部抽吸物、用於 Xpert MTB/RIF Ultra 檢測的糞便以及用於結核病脂阿拉伯甘露聚醣檢測的尿液。在非 eTB-T 組中，結核病治療

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between March 15, 2020, and Jan 31, 2024, 563 participants were enrolled; 558 were analysed after excluding five patients who did not meet eligibility criteria. 276 participants were allocated to the eTB-T groups (n=140 eTB-T and n=136 valganciclovir plus eTB-T) and 282 to the non-eTB-T groups (n=142 SoC and n=140 valganciclovir). 17 (6%) of 276 in the eTB-T groups and 20 (7%) of 282 in the non-eTB-T groups were lost to follow-up. Median age was 4·4 months (IQR 3·2-7·4) and 274 (49%) of participants were female and 284 (51%) were male. In the non-eTB-T groups, 130 (46%) of 282 participants eventually initiated tuberculosis treatment at a median of 4·0 days (IQR 3·0-15·0) after recruitment due to positive microbiological findings in 55 (20%) cases (53 confirmed by tuberculosis lipoarabinomannan assay and two by nasopharyngeal aspirates Xpert MTB/RIF) or clinical decision in 75 (27%) cases. There was no evidence of interaction between valganciclovir and eTB-T (adjusted hazard ratio 1·19, 95% CI 0·73-1·95; pheterogeneity=0·4836). At 12 months, 132 (48%) of 276 participants in eTB-T groups and 121 (43%) of 282 participants in non-eTB-T groups died. In the eTB-T groups, the adjusted hazard ratio for death was 1·12 (95% CI 0·87-1·43; p=0·3868). At 15 days, the odds ratio was 1·24 (95% CI 0·83-1·84; p=0·2950). Serious adverse events did not differ between groups (1·19, 0·82-1·73; p=0·3523). There were no treatment-related deaths. The most common adverse events were elevation of transaminases (72 [26%] cases in the eTB-T groups and 74 [26%] in the non-eTB-T group), anaemia (163 [59%] cases in the eTB-T groups and 169 [60%] in the non-eTB-T groups), and infectious disease requiring antimicrobial treatment (161 [58%] cases in the eTB-T groups and 176 [62%] in the non-eTB-T groups).

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: In contrast to empirical treatment with valganciclovir, there was no evidence that eTB-T was superior to a clinically and microbiologically guided strategy in reducing all-cause mortality among infants with HIV-associated pneumonia. However, the high proportion of infants who eventually initiated tuberculosis treatment during follow-up in the non-eTB-T groups might have reduced the contrast between strategies and attenuated the ability to detect differences in outcomes.

articles.title: First-line pembrolizumab versus carboplatin plus paclitaxel in participants with mismatch repair-deficient advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer (KEYNOTE-C93/GOG-3064/ENGOT-en15): interim analysis of a multicentre, open-label, randomised, active-comparator controlled, phase 3 trial
articles.authors: Slomovitz BM, Zhu J, Yin R, Backes F, Bidziński M, Gilbert L, Willmott LJ, Hasegawa K, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: A need exists for first-line chemotherapy-free options in advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer. We therefore assessed the efficacy, quality of life, and safety of first-line pembrolizumab versus carboplatin plus paclitaxel in mismatch repair-deficient (dMMR) advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer.
abstract.textZh: 晚期或復發性子宮內膜癌需要一線非化療選項。因此，我們評估了在錯配修復缺陷型 (dMMR) 晚期或復發性子宮內膜癌中，一線治療使用 pembrolizumab 與使用卡鉑合併紫杉醇的療效、生活品質和安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: The KEYNOTE-C93/GOG-3064/ENGOT-en15 multicentre, open-label, randomised, active-comparator controlled, phase 3 trial was conducted at 122 centres in 24 countries in the Americas, Asia, Europe, and Oceania. Adult participants (≥18 years) with inoperable, stage III or IV, persistent, advanced, or recurrent dMMR endometrial cancer were randomly assigned 1:1 to intravenous pembrolizumab 400 mg every 6 weeks for up to 18 cycles or intravenous carboplatin area under the curve 5 mg/mL or 6 mg/mL per min plus paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 on day 1 of each 3-week cycle for six cycles. Randomisation was stratified by disease status, histology, and previous receipt of (neo)adjuvant chemotherapy. Primary endpoints were progression-free survival per RECIST version 1.1, by blinded independent central review, and overall survival. This trial is registered at ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT05173987, and is ongoing.

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Feb 22, 2022, and Dec 12, 2023, 299 participants were assigned to pembrolizumab (n=149) or carboplatin plus paclitaxel (n=150). At the cutoff for the prespecified interim analysis in the intention-to-treat population (April 24, 2026), median progression-free survival was 38·2 months (95% CI 17·9 months-not reached) in the pembrolizumab group versus 8·4 months (6·8-10·4) in the carboplatin plus paclitaxel group (hazard ratio [HR] 0·57, 95% CI 0·42-0·79; p=0·0002). Estimated progression-free survival was 75% (95% CI 67-81) versus 76% (68-82) at 6 months, 67% (59-74) versus 40% (32-48) at 12 months, and 53% (44-61) versus 30% (22-38) at 36 months. The prespecified statistical significance criterion for overall survival was not met at the interim analysis (medians not reached; HR 0·77, 95% CI 0·52-1·15; p=0·10). Grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events occurred in 27 (18%) of 149 participants in the pembrolizumab group and 73 (51%) of 144 in the carboplatin plus paclitaxel group. Treatment-related adverse events of any grade that occurred in at least 25% of participants in either group included alopecia (three [2%] of 149 in the pembrolizumab group, 72 [50%] of 144 in the carboplatin plus paclitaxel group), anaemia (seven [5%], 71 [49%]), nausea (seven [5%], 41 [28%]), decreased neutrophil count (five [3%], 40 [28%]), peripheral neuropathy (none, 38 [26%]), and fatigue (20 [13%], 37 [26%]). Treatment-related adverse events led to treatment discontinuation in 14 (9%) of 149 participants in the pembrolizumab group and 21 (15%) of 144 participants in the carboplatin plus paclitaxel group; they resulted in death in two participants in the pembrolizumab group (hepatic failure and bacterial meningitis [n=1 each]) and one participant in the carboplatin plus paclitaxel group (pulmonary embolism).

articles.title: 14-day versus 28-day trifluridine-tipiracil plus bevacizumab for refractory metastatic colorectal cancer (PRABITAS): a pragmatic, multicentre, open-label, randomised, phase 3, non-inferiority trial in Japan
articles.authors: Sakakida T, Taniguchi H, Asayama M, Suwa Y, Shimura T, Mitani S, Makiyama A, Arai H, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Trifluridine-tipiracil (FTD-TPI) plus bevacizumab is the standard treatment for refractory metastatic colorectal cancer. However, the conventional schedule is frequently associated with haematological and gastrointestinal toxicity, which is clinically significant and relevant to patients. A simplified 14-day schedule has been proposed to reduce toxicity, but whether this treatment preserves survival has not been established in a randomised trial. We therefore aimed to assess whether the 14-day schedule is non-inferior to the conventional schedule for overall survival.
abstract.textZh: 曲氟尿苷-泰匹瑞西 (FTD-TPI) 聯合貝伐珠單抗是治療難治性轉移性大腸直腸癌的標準療法。然而，傳統療程經常與血液和胃腸道毒性有關，這在臨床上具有重要意義，且與患者息息相關。為了降低毒性，已提出一種簡化的 14 天療程，但尚未在隨機試驗中確定該治療是否能維持存活期。因此，我們的目標是評估 14 天療程在整體存活期方面是否不遜於傳統療程。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: PRABITAS was a pragmatic, multicentre, open-label, randomised, phase 3, non-inferiority trial conducted in 178 hospitals in Japan. Patients with refractory metastatic colorectal cancer were randomly assigned (1:1) using a minimisation algorithm, stratified by Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status, RAS mutational status, and institution, to FTD-TPI (35 mg/m2 orally twice daily) plus bevacizumab (5 mg/kg intravenously) on either a conventional 28-day (FTD-TPI on days 1-5 and 8-12; bevacizumab on days 1 and 15) or 14-day schedule (FTD-TPI on days 1-5; bevacizumab on day 1). Eligibility criteria were broadened compared with those of conventional explanatory trials, and trial procedures were aligned with routine clinical practice. The primary endpoint was overall survival, analysed in the intention-to-treat population, with a prespecified non-inferiority margin of 1·25. Safety was assessed in all patients who received at least one dose. Missing data were not imputed. This trial is registered with the Japan Registry of Clinical Trials, jRCTs041230120, and is closed to enrolment.
abstract.textZh: PRABITAS 是一項實用性、多中心、開放標籤、隨機、第 3 期、非劣效性試驗，在日本 178 家醫院進行。使用最小化演算法，依美國東岸癌症臨床研究合作組織 (Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group) 的體能狀態、RAS 突變狀態和醫療機構進行分層，將難治性轉移性大腸直腸癌患者隨機分配（1:1）至 FTD-TPI（35 mg/m2，每日兩次口服）合併貝伐單抗（5 mg/kg，靜脈注射）的治療組，採用傳統的 28 天（FTD-TPI 在第 1-5 天和第 8-12 天；貝伐單抗在第 1 天和第 15 天）或 14 天的療程（FTD-TPI 在第 1-5 天；貝伐單抗在第 1 天）。與傳統的解釋性試驗相比，本試驗的入選標準有所放寬，且試驗程序與常規臨床實踐保持一致。主要療效指標是整體存活期，在意圖治療族群中進行分析，預先指定的非劣效性邊界為 1·25。對所有至少接受過一次劑量的患者進行了安全性評估。未對缺失資料進行估算。本試驗已在日本臨床試驗登記處（Japan Registry of Clinical Trials）登記，登記號碼為 jRCTs041230120，且已停止招募受試者。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Dec 26, 2023, and May 20, 2025, we randomly assigned 972 patients, of whom 970 (99%) constituted the intention-to-treat population after two were excluded because they were randomly assigned before site approval (486 [50%] to the 28-day treatment group, 292 [60%] men and 194 [40%] women]; and 484 [50%] to the 14-day treatment group, 264 [55%] men and 220 [45%] women). Median follow-up was 17·9 months (IQR 14·3-22·6). Median overall survival was 10·3 months (95% CI 9·5-11·6) in the 28-day group and 11·3 months (10·2-12·5) in the 14-day group (stratified hazard ratio 0·93 [95% CI 0·80-1·08]). The 12-month overall survival rates were 44·0% (95% CI 39·5-48·5) in the 28-day group and 47·5% (42·9-52·0) in the 14-day group. Neutropenia grade 3 or worse was reduced in the 14-day group (13% vs 39%; absolute difference 25 percentage points [95% CI 20-31]), as was anorexia grade 2 or worse (15% vs 26%; absolute difference 11 percentage points [6-16]). Two treatment-related deaths occurred in the 14-day group and none in the 28-day group.
abstract.textZh: 在 2023 年 12 月 26 日至 2025 年 5 月 20 日期間，我們隨機分配了 972 名患者，其中 970 名 (99%) 構成意圖治療族群，因為有 2 名患者在試驗中心核准前被隨機分配而被排除（486 名 [50%] 被分配至 28 天治療組，其中 292 名 [60%] 為男性，194 名 [40%] 為女性）；484 名 [50%] 被分配至 14 天治療組，其中 264 名 [55%] 為男性，220 名 [45%] 為女性）。中位數追蹤時間為 17.9 個月（四分位距 14.3-22.6）。28 天組的整體存活期中位數為 10.3 個月（95% CI 9.5-11.6），14 天組的整體存活期中位數為 11.3 個月（10.2-12.5）（分層風險比為 0.93 [95% CI 0.80-1.08]）。12 個月的整體存活率在 28 天組為 44·0% (95% CI 39·5-48·5)，在 14 天組為 47·5% (42·9-52·0)。14 天組中，第 3 級或更嚴重的嗜中性白血球減少症有所減少（13% 對 39%；絕對差異為 25 個百分點 [95% CI 20-31]），第 2 級或更嚴重的食慾不振也有所減少（15% 對 26%；絕對差異為 11 個百分點 [6-16]）。14 天組別發生兩例與治療相關的死亡，而 28 天組別則無。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: A 14-day schedule of FTD-TPI plus bevacizumab was non-inferior to the conventional 28-day schedule for overall survival, while reducing haematological and gastrointestinal toxicity. These findings support this simplified schedule as the new standard for FTD-TPI plus bevacizumab in refractory metastatic colorectal cancer.
abstract.textZh: 在整體存活期方面，FTD-TPI 聯合貝伐珠單抗的 14 天療程不遜於傳統的 28 天療程，同時還降低了血液和胃腸道毒性。這些發現支持將此簡化療程作為 FTD-TPI 聯合貝伐珠單抗治療難治性轉移性大腸癌的新標準。

articles.title: Ambient scribes as narrative technologies
articles.authors: Ostherr K, Engebretsen E, Woods A

abstract.text: Ambient scribes, also known as artificial intelligence-powered voice-to-text technology, are widely cited as time-saving tools that reduce administrative burden for clinicians. Yet, in their current use, these tools pose substantial, often unacknowledged risks that threaten to undermine patient-centred care. We argue that ambient scribes are inherently narrative technologies whose risks-and potential benefits-cannot be fully understood without careful attention to the ways that patients tell their stories and the broader context in which those stories are told. Drawing on medical humanities scholarship, we show that current approaches to ambient scribes take a superficial approach to narrative interpretation that omits the clinically relevant aspects of patient experience. We propose three ways to integrate more robust narrative analysis that can increase the value of ambient scribes: centring patient perspectives, accounting for material and social structures that shape narrative, and reframing the clinical encounter as a node in a broader narrative system. We conclude by outlining five priorities for commissioners, administrators, clinical leaders, and practice managers to ensure that the roll-out of ambient scribes does not deepen existing harms, and could instead contribute to more humane and trustworthy care.
abstract.textZh: 環境記錄員，又稱為人工智慧驅動的語音轉文字技術，被廣泛認為是節省時間的工具，可減輕臨床醫生的行政負擔。然而，在目前的應用中，這些工具帶來了重大的、往往未被察覺的風險，可能損害以患者為中心的照護。我們認為，環境記錄工具本質上是敘事技術，如果不仔細關注患者講述其故事的方式，以及講述這些故事的更廣泛背景，就無法充分理解其風險與潛在益處。根據醫學人文學的研究，我們指出，目前對環境記錄工具的應用方式在敘事解讀上採取了膚淺的態度，忽略了患者經驗中與臨床相關的層面。我們提出三種方法來整合更健全的敘事分析，以提升環境記錄工具的價值：以患者觀點為中心、考量塑造敘事的物質與社會結構，以及將臨床診療重新定位為更廣泛敘事系統中的一個節點。最後，我們概述了委託人、行政人員、臨床領導者和診所經理的五大優先事項，以確保環境記錄工具的推行不會加深現有的傷害，反而能有助於提供更人性化、更值得信賴的照護。

articles.authors: Moraleda C, Tagarro A, Domínguez-Rodríguez S, Musiime V, Mujuru H, Chabala C, Mvalo T, Iroh-Tam PY, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Mortality among infants with severe HIV-associated pneumonia remains high. This trial (EMPIRICAL) tested whether empirical valganciclovir treatment for cytomegalovirus improves survival in infants in Africa.
abstract.textZh: 患有嚴重人類免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）相關性肺炎的嬰兒死亡率仍然很高。本試驗（EMPIRICAL）旨在測試使用 valganciclovir 進行巨細胞病毒的經驗性治療是否能改善非洲嬰兒的存活率。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This multicentre, open-label, group-sequential designed, 2 × 2 factorial, randomised, controlled, superiority trial was conducted in 19 hospitals across Côte d'Ivoire, Malawi, Mozambique, Uganda, Zambia, and Zimbabwe. Infants aged 28-365 days admitted with severe HIV-associated pneumonia were centrally and individually randomly assigned (1:1:1:1) using a secure web-based system stratified by site and severity to receive standard of care (SOC) comprising treatment for bacterial (WHO-recommended antibiotics) and Pneumocystis jirovecii (cotrimoxazole and steroids) pneumonia, SOC plus 15 days of oral valganciclovir (16 mg/kg per 12 h), or SOC plus 6 months of tuberculosis treatment (isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol for 2 months, plus isoniazid and rifampicin for 4 subsequent months), or both interventions combined. The primary endpoint was all-cause mortality, assessed at day 15 and over 1-year follow-up in the intention-to-treat population. In this Article, we report results for the valganciclovir comparison groups. The trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT03915366 and is complete.
abstract.textZh: 這項多中心、開放標籤、群組順序設計、2 × 2 因子設計、隨機、對照、優效性試驗在象牙海岸、馬拉威、莫三比克、烏干達、尚比亞和辛巴威的 19 家醫院進行。年齡在 28 至 365 天之間、因重度 HIV 相關肺炎而住院的嬰兒，使用依據研究中心和嚴重程度分層的安全網路系統，以集中和個別隨機分配的方式（1:1:1:1）接受標準照護（SOC），包括細菌性肺炎（世界衛生組織建議的抗生素）和肺囊蟲肺炎（複方新諾明和類固醇）的治療、SOC 加上 15 天的口服 valganciclovir（每 12 小時 16 毫克/公斤），或 SOC 加上 6 個月的結核病治療（異菸肼、利福平、吡嗪醯胺和乙胺丁醇治療 2 個月，加上異菸肼和利福平治療接下來的 4 個月），或兩者合併治療。主要療效指標為所有原因的死亡率，在意圖治療族群中於第 15 天和超過 1 年的追蹤期進行評估。在本文中，我們報告了 valganciclovir 對照組的結果。該試驗已在 ClinicalTrials.gov 上註冊，編號為 NCT03915366，且已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: From March 15, 2020, to Jan 31, 2024, 563 participants were enrolled; 558 were included in the analyses, with 276 allocated to valganciclovir groups (140 valganciclovir; 136 valganciclovir plus tuberculosis treatment) and 282 to groups without valganciclovir (142 SOC; 140 tuberculosis treatment). The median patient age was 4·4 months (IQR 3·2-7·4), and 274 (49%) were female. There was no evidence of interaction between valganciclovir and tuberculosis treatment (adjusted hazard ratio 1·19 [95% CI 0·73-1·95], heterogeneity p=0·48). At day 15, 64 (23%) of 276 participants in the valganciclovir group and 76 (27%) of 282 in groups without valganciclovir died (rate ratio 0·81 [95% CI 0·61-1·08], p=0·15). 24 (9%) of 276 participants and 13 (5%) of 282, respectively, were lost to follow-up. After 12 months, 119 (43%) of 276 participants in the valganciclovir groups and 134 (48%) of 282 in the groups without valganciclovir died (0·88 [95% CI 0·74-1·05] p=0·15). In a time-varying effects model, at day 15, the adjusted hazard ratio of death was 0·60 (95% CI 0·41-0·87, p=0·0063), and their hazard of death over 1 year was 0·79 (0·62-1·01; p=0·068), or 0·76 (0·58-1·00; p=0·0500) when excluding deaths within 48 h of treatment. Severe adverse events during follow-up were not more common in the valganciclovir treatment groups (odds ratio 0·64 [95% CI 0·35-1·16]).
abstract.textZh: 從 2020 年 3 月 15 日至 2024 年 1 月 31 日，共有 563 名參與者入組；其中 558 名參與者被納入分析，276 名參與者被分配至 valganciclovir 組（140 名參與者接受 valganciclovir；136 名參與者接受 valganciclovir 加上結核病治療），282 名參與者被分配至未接受 valganciclovir 的組別（142 名參與者接受標準照護；140 名參與者接受結核病治療）。患者的年齡中位數為 4.4 個月（四分位距 3.2-7.4），其中 274 人（49%）為女性。沒有證據顯示 valganciclovir 與結核病治療之間存在交互作用（調整後的風險比為 1·19 [95% CI 0·73-1·95]，異質性 p=0·48）。在第 15 天， valganciclovir 組的 276 名參與者中有 64 名（23%）死亡，而未接受 valganciclovir 治療的 282 名參與者中有 76 名（27%）死亡（發生率比 0·81 [95% CI 0·61-1·08]，p=0·15）。分別有 276 名參與者中的 24 名（9%）和 282 名參與者中的 13 名（5%）失訪。12 個月後， valganciclovir 組的 276 名參與者中有 119 名（43%）死亡，而未接受 valganciclovir 治療的 282 名參與者中有 134 名（48%）死亡（0·88 [95% CI 0·74-1·05] p=0·15）。在時間變異效應模型中，在第 15 天時，死亡的調整後風險比為 0·60（95% CI 0·41-0·87，p=0·0063），其 1 年內的死亡風險為 0·79（0·62-1·01；p=0·068），或在排除治療後 48 小時內的死亡時為 0·76（0·58-1·00；p=0·0500）。在追蹤期間， valganciclovir 治療組的嚴重不良事件並未更為常見（勝算比 0·64 [95% CI 0·35-1·16]）。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Empirical valganciclovir treatment appeared to be associated with a lower hazard of death in infants with severe HIV-associated pneumonia than SOC alone or SOC plus empirical tuberculosis treatment, and there was little evidence of associated harms.
abstract.textZh: 與單獨使用標準治療或標準治療合併經驗性結核病治療相比，經驗性 valganciclovir 治療似乎與重度 HIV 相關性肺炎嬰兒的死亡風險較低有關，且幾乎沒有證據顯示存在相關危害。

articles.title: Fluid eMTBR-tau243 as a Biomarker of Mixed 3-Repeat and 4-Repeat Tau Pathology
articles.authors: Horie K, Koppisetti RK, VandeVrede L, Asken BM, Li Y, Yen D, Ghoshal N, Paterson RW, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Neurodegenerative diseases with abnormal tau protein aggregation in the brain (ie, tauopathies) can be classified by the tau isoform that accumulates: 3-repeat (3R), 4-repeat (4R), or mixed 3R/4R tauopathies, which include chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), some forms of frontotemporal lobar degeneration, and Alzheimer disease (AD). The endogenously cleaved form of tau microtubule binding region containing the residue 243 (eMTBR-tau243) can be detected in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and blood and has been associated with AD tau pathology, but its specificity and biological interpretation in non-AD tauopathies remains unclear.
abstract.textZh: 大腦中存在異常 tau 蛋白聚集的神經退化性疾病（即 tau 病變）可依據累積的 tau 同型體進行分類：3 重複 (3R)、4 重複 (4R) 或混合型 3R/4R tau 病變，其中包括慢性創傷性腦病變 (CTE)、某些類型的額顳葉退化症以及阿茲海默症 (AD)。含有殘基 243 的 tau 微管結合區域的內源性裂解形式（eMTBR-tau243）可在腦脊髓液（CSF）和血液中檢測到，並且與 AD tau 病理學有關，但其在非 AD tau 病變中的特異性和生物學解釋仍不清楚。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate biofluid eMTBR-tau243 in a range of tauopathies.
abstract.textZh: 評估多種tau蛋白病變中的體液 eMTBR-tau243。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: This case-control study included 4 biorepositories based in the US that contributed CSF and plasma samples from participants with and without tauopathies, many of whom had antemortem biofluid samples paired with autopsy or genetically defined neuropathology. Samples were analyzed between August 2023 and December 2025. Data analysis occurred from August 2024 to July 2026.
abstract.textZh: 這項病例對照研究納入了 4 家位於美國的生物樣本庫，這些樣本庫提供了來自有或無tau蛋白病變參與者的腦脊液和血漿樣本，其中許多參與者有生前生物體液樣本，並與屍體解剖或基因確定的神經病理學結果相匹配。檢體分析期間為 2023 年 8 月至 2025 年 12 月。資料分析於 2024 年 8 月至 2026 年 7 月期間進行。

abstract.label: EXPOSURE
abstract.text: CSF and plasma eMTBR-tau243 concentrations measured using a mass spectrometry-based assay.
abstract.textZh: 使用基於質譜的檢測方法測量的腦脊液和血漿 eMTBR-tau243 濃度。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: Outcomes included mixed 3R/4R tauopathy (eg, AD and CTE) based on autopsy, frontotemporal lobar degeneration with MAPT variants (FTLD-MAPT), and CTE stage. Differences in biomarker levels between groups were evaluated using analysis of variance or analysis of covariance, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) was calculated to evaluate the discriminative performance of fluid eMTBR-tau243.
abstract.textZh: 結果包括根據屍體解剖的混合型 3R/4R tau 蛋白病變（例如，AD 和 CTE）、帶有 MAPT 變異體的額顳葉退化症（FTLD-MAPT）以及 CTE 分期。使用變異數分析或共變異數分析評估各組間生物標誌物濃度的差異，並計算受試者操作特性曲線下面積 (AUC)，以評估體液 eMTBR-tau243 的區分效能。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among the 229 participants (196 with CSF samples and 55 with plasma samples [22 with both]), mean (SD) age at fluid sample collection was 63 (13) years and 108 (47%) were female. Median (IQR) CSF eMTBR-tau243 was increased in 10 patients with AD (0.459 [0.246-0.801] fmol/mL) compared with 29 cognitively unimpaired controls (0.002 [0.001-0.005] fmol/mL) (adjusted P < .001), but other autopsy-confirmed non-AD tauopathies (which included 52 individuals with conditions including progressive supranuclear palsy and corticobasal degeneration) did not demonstrate an increase (0.015 [0.008, 0.039] fmol/mL). Six symptomatic FTLD-MAPT variant carriers with mixed 3R/4R tauopathy (R406W, V337M, and G389R) had increased median (IQR) CSF eMTBR-tau243 (0.140 [0.055-0.174] fmol/mL) compared with 15 4R tauopathy variant carriers including N279K and P301L (0.004 [0.001-0.044] fmol/mL) (P = .001). Median (IQR) plasma eMTBR-tau243 was increased in 11 patients with CTE (1.93 [0.42-3.68] fmol/L) compared with 20 cognitively unimpaired controls (0.29 [0.05-0.62] fmol/L) (adjusted P = .007), but did not increase as high as among 14 patients with AD (11.25 [2.29-19.38] fmol/L). Plasma eMTBR-tau243 distinguished CTE stage III and IV from controls (AUC, 0.97; 95% CI, 0.92-1.00), but not CTE stage I from controls (AUC, 0.64; 95% CI, 0.32-0.97).
abstract.textZh: 在 229 名參與者中（196 名提供腦脊液樣本，55 名提供血漿樣本 [22 名同時提供兩種樣本]），收集體液樣本時的平均 (SD) 年齡為 63 (13) 歲，其中 108 人 (47%) 為女性。與 29 名認知功能無損害的對照組（0.002 [0.001-0.005] fmol/mL）相比，10 名 AD 患者的腦脊液 eMTBR-tau243 中位數（IQR）有所增加（0.459 [0.246-0.801] fmol/mL）（調整後 P < 0.001），但其他經屍檢證實的非 AD tau 病變（包括 52 名患有進行性核上性麻痺和皮質基底核變性等疾病的個體）並未顯示出增加（0.015 [0.008, 0.039] fmol/mL）。與 15 名 4R tau 病變變異體攜帶者（包括 N279K 和 P301L）（0.004 [0.001-0.044] fmol/mL）相比，6 名具有混合型 3R/4R tau 病變（R406W、V337M 和 G389R）的有症狀 FTLD-MAPT 變異體攜帶者的腦脊液 eMTBR-tau243 中位數（IQR）升高（0.140 [0.055-0.174] fmol/mL）（P = 0.001）。與 20 名認知功能無損害的對照組（0.29 [0.05-0.62] fmol/L）相比，11 名 CTE 患者的血漿 eMTBR-tau243 中位數（IQR）有所增加（1.93 [0.42-3.68] fmol/L）（調整後 P = 0.007），但未達到 14 名 AD 患者的水平（11.25 [2.29-19.38] fmol/L）。血漿 eMTBR-tau243 可區分 CTE 第 III 期和第 IV 期與對照組（AUC，0.97；95% CI，0.92-1.00），但無法區分 CTE 第 I 期與對照組（AUC，0.64；95% CI，0.32-0.97）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: This study found that plasma and CSF eMTBR-tau243 were increased in mixed 3R/4R tauopathies including AD, high-stage CTE, and a subset of genetic FTLD-MAPT, compared with cognitively unimpaired controls. Further validation in larger cohorts is needed to determine the clinical utility of eMTBR-tau243 as a potential diagnostic biomarker for CTE and other tauopathies beyond AD.
abstract.textZh: 本研究發現，與認知功能無損害的對照組相比，在混合型 3R/4R tau 蛋白病變（包括 AD、晚期 CTE 和一部分遺傳性 FTLD-MAPT）中，血漿和腦脊液中的 eMTBR-tau243 水準有所升高。需要對更大規模的群體進行進一步驗證，以確定 eMTBR-tau243 作為 CTE 和 AD 以外其他 tau 病變潛在診斷生物標誌物的臨床應用價值。

articles.titleZh: 作為混合 3 重複與 4 重複 Tau 病理的生物標誌物的體液 eMTBR-tau243

articles.title: Preventing Malaria Infections and Moving toward Malaria Elimination
articles.authors: Tchouatieu AM, Wells TNC, Achan J

abstract.text: Malaria continues to be a major health challenge worldwide, causing an estimated 282 million cases of illness and 610,000 deaths in 2024, predominantly among African children. Despite recent stagnation in the progress of malaria prevention, the landscape is undergoing rapid transformation. This review examines current and emerging approaches to preventing malaria infection and supporting malaria elimination, including vector control, transmission-blocking interventions, chemoprevention, monoclonal antibodies, and vaccines. Next-generation insecticide-treated nets, expanded use of seasonal malaria chemoprevention, and the introduction of RTS,S/AS01 and R21/Matrix-M vaccines are already reshaping control strategies. Looking ahead, long-acting injectable chemoprevention, transmission-blocking medicines and vaccines, and improved surveillance-driven deployment may further accelerate progress. As funding becomes constrained and decision making shifts increasingly to countries where malaria is endemic, effective malaria prevention will depend on locally tailored, integrated combinations of interventions supported by strong surveillance, regulatory capacity, and national leadership.
abstract.textZh: 瘧疾仍是全球主要的健康挑戰，估計在 2024 年造成 2.82 億人感染，並導致 61 萬人死亡，其中以非洲兒童為主。儘管近年來瘧疾預防的進展停滯不前，但整體情況正在迅速變化。本篇綜述探討了當前和新興的預防瘧疾感染及支持瘧疾根除的方法，包括病媒控制、阻斷傳播的干預措施、化學預防、單株抗體和疫苗。新一代的長效蚊帳、季節性瘧疾化學預防的擴大使用，以及 RTS,S/AS01 和 R21/Matrix-M 疫苗的引進，已經在重塑瘧疾防治策略。展望未來，長效型注射式化學預防、阻斷傳播的藥物與疫苗，以及更完善的監測導向部署，都有望進一步加速進展。隨著資金日益緊張，且決策權日益轉移至瘧疾流行國家，有效的瘧疾預防將有賴於在強大監測、監管能力和國家領導力支持下，採用因地制宜、綜合多種干預措施的組合。

articles.title: Prevention of Venous Thromboembolism after Total Hip or Knee Replacement
articles.authors: Pellegrini VD, Lambourne CA, Magder LS, Franklin PD, Magaziner JS, Martin BI, Iorio R, Garvin KL, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Studies comparing aspirin with anticoagulants for venous thromboembolism (VTE) prophylaxis after total hip or knee arthroplasty have had conflicting results.
abstract.textZh: 比較阿斯匹靈與抗凝血劑在全髖關節或全膝關節置換術後預防靜脈血栓栓塞 (VTE) 的研究結果存在分歧。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In a comparative-effectiveness noninferiority trial, we randomly assigned patients undergoing elective hip or knee arthroplasty to receive aspirin (81 mg twice daily), warfarin (to a target international normalized ratio of 2.0), or rivaroxaban (10 mg daily) for 30 days. The composite primary effectiveness outcome (death from any cause or symptomatic VTE) and primary safety outcome (bleeding, reoperation for wound problems, or myocardial infarction) were evaluated through 6 months in a blinded fashion. The noninferiority margin for the risk difference was 0.69 percentage points.
abstract.textZh: 在一項比較療效的非劣效性試驗中，我們將接受擇期髖關節或膝關節置換術的患者隨機分配至以下三組：阿斯匹靈（每日兩次，每次 81 毫克）、華法林（目標國際標準化比值為 2.0）或利伐沙班（每日 10 毫克），為期 30 天。以盲態方式在 6 個月內評估複合主要療效結果（任何原因導致的死亡或有症狀的 VTE）和主要安全性結果（出血、因傷口問題再次手術或心肌梗塞）。風險差異的非劣效性邊界為 0.69 個百分點。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 18,883 participants who had undergone randomization, 15,317 (7214 with hip arthroplasty and 8103 with knee arthroplasty) were included in the primary per-protocol analysis. A primary effectiveness outcome event occurred in 77 of 6090 participants (1.26%) in the aspirin group, in 52 of 4231 (1.23%) in the warfarin group, and in 47 of 4996 (0.94%) in the rivaroxaban group; a primary safety outcome event occurred in 177 (2.91%), 142 (3.36%), and 174 (3.48%), respectively. In pairwise comparisons, 6-month risks of a primary effectiveness outcome event were 1.24% and 0.94% for aspirin versus rivaroxaban (difference, 0.30 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.20 to 0.81); 1.24% and 1.01% for aspirin versus warfarin (difference, 0.23 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.34 to 0.81); and 1.13% and 1.10% for warfarin versus rivaroxaban (difference, 0.03 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.57 to 0.63). Risks of a primary safety outcome event were 3.70% and 3.02% for rivaroxaban versus aspirin (difference, 0.68 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.04 to 1.41); 3.65% and 2.88% for warfarin versus aspirin (difference, 0.77 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.04 to 1.58); and 3.59% and 3.61% for rivaroxaban versus warfarin (difference, -0.02 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.89 to 0.85). Intention-to-treat analyses yielded similar results.
abstract.textZh: 在 18,883 名已接受隨機分組的參與者中，15,317 名（7,214 名接受髖關節置換術，8,103 名接受膝關節置換術）被納入主要依計畫分析。阿斯匹靈組 6090 名參與者中有 77 名（1.26%）發生主要療效結果事件，華法林組 4231 名參與者中有 52 名（1.23%）發生主要療效結果事件，利伐沙班組 4996 名參與者中有 47 名（0.94%）發生主要療效結果事件；分別有 177 名（2.91%）、142 名（3.36%）和 174 名（3.48%）發生主要安全性結果事件。在成對比較中，阿斯匹靈與利伐沙班相比，6 個月的主要療效結果事件風險分別為 1.24% 和 0.94%（差異為 0.30 個百分點；95% 信賴區間 [CI] 為 -0.20 至 0.81）；阿斯匹靈與華法林相比，分別為 1.24% 和 1.01%（差異為 0.23 個百分點；95% CI 為 -0.34 至 0.81）；華法林與利伐沙班相比，分別為 1.13% 和 1.10%（差異為 0.03 個百分點；95% CI 為 -0.57 至 0.63）。利伐沙班組與阿斯匹靈組的主要安全性結果事件風險分別為 3.70% 和 3.02%（差異為 0.68 個百分點；95% CI：-0.04 至 1.41）；華法林組與阿斯匹靈組的主要安全性結果事件風險分別為 3.65% 和 2.88%（差異為 0.77 個百分點；95% CI：-0.04 至 1.58）；利伐沙班組與華法林組的主要安全性結果事件風險分別為 3.59% 和 3.61%（差異為 -0.02 個百分點；95% CI：-0.89 至 0.85）。意圖治療分析得到類似的結果。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Aspirin prophylaxis after total hip or knee arthroplasty was not noninferior to rivaroxaban or warfarin with respect to death or symptomatic VTE. Warfarin and rivaroxaban were not noninferior to aspirin for safety. (Funded by the Patient-Centered Outcomes Research Institute; PEPPER ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT02810704.).
abstract.textZh: 在全髖關節或全膝關節置換術後，就死亡或有症狀的靜脈血栓栓塞症 (VTE) 而言，阿斯匹靈預防性治療並不遜於利伐沙班或華法林。在安全性方面，華法林與利伐沙班並不遜於阿斯匹靈。（由以患者為中心的結果研究機構資助；PEPPER ClinicalTrials.gov 編號：NCT02810704）。

articles.titleZh: 全髖關節或全膝關節置換術後靜脈血栓栓塞的預防

articles.title: Ravulizumab in IgA Nephropathy - Interim Analysis of a Phase 3 Trial
articles.authors: Barratt J, Farag YMK, Rice K, Cammett TJ, Inker LA, Trimarchi H, Bruchfeld A, Heerspink HJL, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: In patients with IgA nephropathy, complement activation drives glomerular inflammation, which leads to hematuria, proteinuria, and nephron loss. Ravulizumab is a terminal complement inhibitor that prevents formation of C5a and C5b-9.
abstract.textZh: 在 IgA 腎病變患者中，補體活化會引發腎小球發炎，進而導致血尿、蛋白尿和腎元喪失。Ravulizumab 是一種終末補體抑制劑，可防止 C5a 和 C5b-9 的形成。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this phase 3 trial, we enrolled adults with IgA nephropathy who had an estimated glomerular filtration rate of at least 30 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 of body-surface area and proteinuria (24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio [with protein and creatinine both measured in grams] of ≥0.75 or total urinary protein excretion of ≥1.0 g per day), despite standard therapy. Patients were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive an intravenous infusion of either ravulizumab or placebo every 8 weeks. In the prespecified interim analysis, the primary efficacy end point was the change from baseline in the 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio at week 34. Safety was also assessed.
abstract.textZh: 在這項第 3 期試驗中，我們招募了患有 IgA 腎病變的成年患者，這些患者的估計腎小球濾過率至少為每分鐘 30 毫升／每 1.73 平方公尺體表面積，且儘管接受標準治療，仍有蛋白尿（24 小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比值 [蛋白和肌酸酐均以克為單位測量] ≥0.75 或每日總尿蛋白排泄量 ≥1.0 公克）。患者以 1:1 的比例被隨機分配，每 8 週接受一次 ravulizumab 或安慰劑的靜脈輸注。在預先指定的期中分析中，主要療效終點是第 34 週時 24 小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比值相較於基線的變化。也評估了安全性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In all, 485 patients underwent randomization, with 240 patients assigned to the ravulizumab group and 245 to the placebo group; 352 patients (176 in each group) were included in the interim analysis. In the ravulizumab group, the geometric mean 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio at baseline and at week 34 was 1.56 and 0.83, respectively; in the placebo group, it was 1.60 and 1.48, respectively. At week 34, a significant reduction in the geometric mean 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio was observed with ravulizumab (-46.6%) as compared with the reduction observed with placebo (-5.6%), corresponding to an adjusted geometric mean 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio that was 43.4% (99% confidence interval, 30.1 to 54.2) lower with ravulizumab than with placebo (P<0.001). Adverse events occurred in 69.5% of the patients receiving ravulizumab and in 75.8% of those receiving placebo; serious adverse events occurred in 4.6% and 9.0%, respectively. No meningococcal infections or deaths occurred.
abstract.textZh: 總共有 485 名患者接受隨機分組，其中 240 名患者被分配到 ravulizumab 組，245 名患者被分配到安慰劑組；352 名患者（每組 176 名）被納入期中分析。在 ravulizumab 組中，基線和第 34 週的幾何平均 24 小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比值分別為 1.56 和 0.83；在安慰劑組中，該比值分別為 1.60 和 1.48。在第 34 週時，與安慰劑組觀察到的降低幅度 (-5.6%) 相比，ravulizumab 組的幾何平均 24 小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率顯著降低 (-46.6%)，這相當於調整後的幾何平均 24 小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率，使用 ravulizumab 時比使用安慰劑時低 43.4% (99% 信賴區間，30.1 至 54.2) (P<0.001)。69.5% 的 ravulizumab 用藥患者和 75.8% 的安慰劑用藥患者發生不良事件；分別有 4.6% 和 9.0% 的患者發生嚴重不良事件。未發生腦膜炎雙球菌感染或死亡。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In adults with IgA nephropathy, ravulizumab resulted in a significantly greater reduction in the protein-to-creatinine ratio than placebo at week 34. (Funded by Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease Unit; I CAN ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06291376; EU Clinical Trials number, 2023-507851-31-00.).
abstract.textZh: 在患有 IgA 腎病的成人中，與安慰劑相比，ravulizumab 在第 34 週時使蛋白與肌酸酐比率顯著降低。（由 Alexion、AstraZeneca 罕見疾病部門資助；I CAN ClinicalTrials.gov 編號：NCT06291376；歐盟臨床試驗編號：2023-507851-31-00）。

articles.title: Prasugrel versus Ticagrelor in Acute Coronary Syndromes
articles.authors: Omerovic E, Koul S, Andersson J, Pontén J, Björklund F, Kastberg R, Sun M, Ljungman C, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Whether prasugrel or ticagrelor should be the preferred P2Y12 inhibitor for patients with an acute coronary syndrome is uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 對於急性冠心症患者，尚不確定應優先選擇普拉格雷 (prasugrel) 還是替格雷洛 (ticagrelor) 作為 P2Y12 抑制劑。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a registry-based, open-label, stepped-wedge, cluster-randomized trial in Sweden involving adults who had undergone percutaneous coronary intervention for an acute coronary syndrome. Seven regions, grouped into three clusters, switched from ticagrelor to prasugrel as the default P2Y12 inhibitor in a randomized sequence across four 9-month periods between 2021 and 2024. The primary end point was a composite of death from any cause, fatal or nonfatal myocardial infarction, or fatal or nonfatal stroke through 1 year, as ascertained from national registries. In the intention-to-treat analysis, a mixed model adjusted for cluster and calendar time was used to obtain a policy-level estimate.
abstract.textZh: 我們在瑞典進行了一項以登記資料為基礎的開放標籤、逐步楔入式、叢集隨機化試驗，該試驗的對象為因急性冠心症而接受經皮冠狀動脈介入治療的成年人。七個地區被劃分為三個群組，在 2021 年至 2024 年期間的四個 9 個月週期內，以隨機順序將預設的 P2Y12 抑制劑從替卡格雷 (ticagrelor) 切換為普拉格雷 (prasugrel)。主要終點是根據國家登記資料確認的 1 年內因任何原因導致的死亡、致命或非致命性心肌梗塞，或致命或非致命性中風的複合指標。在意圖治療分析中，使用依群組與日曆時間調整的混合模型，以獲得政策層級的估計值。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 17,095 patients were enrolled; 9444 received care under the default ticagrelor policy, and 7651 received care under the default prasugrel policy. The mean (±SD) age of the patients was 69.8±11.5 years, and 36.8% were at least 75 years old; 27.8% of the patients were female. A total of 39.4% presented with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI), 43.7% with non-STEMI, and 16.8% with unstable angina. At 1 year, a primary end-point event had occurred in 11.8% of the patients in the ticagrelor-policy group and in 11.1% of those in the prasugrel-policy group (adjusted odds ratio [prasugrel vs. ticagrelor], 0.90; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.77 to 1.06), and major bleeding had occurred in 4.4% and 4.2%, respectively (adjusted odds ratio, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.64 to 0.99).
abstract.textZh: 共有 17,095 名患者入組；其中 9,444 名患者依預設的替卡格雷政策接受治療，7,651 名患者依預設的普拉格雷政策接受治療。患者的平均 (±SD) 年齡為 69.8±11.5 歲，其中 36.8% 的患者年齡至少為 75 歲；27.8% 的患者為女性。共有 39.4% 的患者出現 ST 段抬高型心肌梗塞 (STEMI)，43.7% 的患者出現非 ST 段抬高型心肌梗塞，16.8% 的患者出現不穩定型心絞痛。在 1 年時，替卡格雷政策組中有 11.8% 的患者發生主要終點事件，普拉格雷政策組中有 11.1% 的患者發生主要終點事件（調整後勝算比 [普拉格雷與替卡格雷] 為 0.90；95% 信賴區間 [CI] 為 0.77 至 1.06），兩組分別有 4.4% 和 4.2% 的患者發生大出血（調整後勝算比為 0.80；95% CI 為 0.64 至 0.99）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In an unselected population of patients with an acute coronary syndrome who had undergone percutaneous coronary intervention, the risk of ischemic events was not lower with a default prasugrel policy than with a default ticagrelor policy. (Funded by Region Västra Götaland; SWITCH-SWEDEHEART ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05183178.).
abstract.textZh: 在一群未經選擇、患有急性冠心症且曾接受經皮冠狀動脈介入治療的患者中，採用預設普拉格雷方案的缺血性事件風險並不低於採用預設替卡格雷方案的風險。（由西約塔蘭省資助；SWITCH-SWEDEHEART ClinicalTrials.gov 編號：NCT05183178）。

articles.title: Rivaroxaban Then Aspirin vs. Aspirin Alone after Total Hip or Knee Arthroplasty
articles.authors: Shivakumar S, Matino D, Zukor D, Kahn SR, Vincent G, Mundi R, Vendittoli PA, Refaei M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Aspirin after an initial short course of rivaroxaban has been shown to be safe and effective for the prevention of venous thromboembolism after total hip or total knee arthroplasty, but uncertainty remains about the use of aspirin alone.
abstract.textZh: 研究顯示，在短期的利伐沙班治療後使用阿斯匹靈，對於預防全髖關節或全膝關節置換術後的靜脈血栓栓塞症是安全且有效的，但對於單獨使用阿斯匹靈仍存在不確定性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multicenter, double-blind, randomized, controlled trial, we assigned patients to receive once-daily thromboprophylaxis with either 81 mg of aspirin or 10 mg of oral rivaroxaban for the first 5 days after total hip or total knee arthroplasty. All the patients then received further thromboprophylaxis with 81 mg of aspirin daily for 9 additional days after knee arthroplasty and for 30 additional days after hip arthroplasty. Patients were followed for 90 days for symptomatic venous thromboembolism, which consisted of either proximal deep-vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism (primary effectiveness outcome), and for bleeding complications (primary safety outcome). The noninferiority margin for aspirin alone as compared with rivaroxaban-aspirin was 0.7 percentage points.
abstract.textZh: 在這項多中心、雙盲、隨機、對照試驗中，我們將患者分配至接受每日一次的血栓預防治療，在全髖關節或全膝關節置換術後的最初 5 天內，分別使用 81 毫克的阿斯匹靈或 10 毫克的口服利伐沙班。所有患者在膝關節置換術後額外 9 天以及髖關節置換術後額外 30 天，每日進一步接受 81 毫克阿斯匹靈的預防性抗凝治療。對患者進行為期 90 天的追蹤，以觀察是否有症狀性靜脈血栓栓塞，包括近端深靜脈血栓或肺栓塞（主要療效指標），以及出血併發症（主要安全性指標）。與利伐沙班合併阿斯匹靈相比，單用阿斯匹靈的非劣效性邊界為 0.7 個百分點。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 5429 patients underwent randomization. Venous thromboembolism developed in 13 of 2718 patients (0.48%) in the aspirin-alone group and in 12 of 2647 patients (0.45%) in the rivaroxaban-aspirin group (risk difference, 0.02 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.34 to 0.39; P<0.001 for noninferiority). Major bleeding or clinically relevant nonmajor bleeding events occurred in 45 of 2718 patients (1.66%) in the aspirin-alone group and in 54 of 2647 patients (2.04%) in the rivaroxaban-aspirin group (risk difference, -0.38%; 95% CI, -1.11 to 0.34).
abstract.textZh: 共有 5429 名患者接受隨機分組。在單用阿斯匹靈組中，2718 名患者中有 13 名 (0.48%) 出現靜脈血栓栓塞；在利伐沙班合併阿斯匹靈組中，2647 名患者中有 12 名 (0.45%) 出現靜脈血栓栓塞（風險差異為 0.02 個百分點；95% 信賴區間 [CI] 為 -0.34 至 0.39；非劣效性 P<0.001）。在單用阿斯匹靈組中，2718 名患者中有 45 名（1.66%）發生大出血或臨床相關的非大出血事件；在利伐沙班合併阿斯匹靈組中，2647 名患者中有 54 名（2.04%）發生大出血或臨床相關的非大出血事件（風險差異為 -0.38%；95% CI 為 -1.11 至 0.34）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: After total hip and total knee arthroplasty, the use of aspirin alone was not inferior to a strategy of using rivaroxaban followed by aspirin for the prevention of symptomatic venous thromboembolism, with no clinically relevant difference in bleeding events. (Funded by the Canadian Institutes of Health Research; EPCAT III ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04075240.).
abstract.textZh: 在全髖關節和全膝關節置換術後，單獨使用阿斯匹靈在預防症狀性靜脈血栓栓塞症方面並不遜於先使用利伐沙班再使用阿斯匹靈的策略，且在出血事件方面沒有臨床相關的差異。（由加拿大衛生研究院資助；EPCAT III ClinicalTrials.gov 編號：NCT04075240）。

articles.title: Lynch syndrome
articles.authors: Ryan NAJ, Gallon R, McVeigh T, Monahan KJ, Moeslein G, Church DN, Domínguez-Valentin M, Smith T

abstract.text: Lynch syndrome is the most common inherited cancer predisposition syndrome, affecting approximately one in 350-450 individuals, yet the majority of carriers remain undiagnosed, representing a substantial and preventable public health burden. Caused by germline pathogenic variants in DNA mismatch repair (MMR) genes, Lynch syndrome confers markedly elevated and heterogeneous risks of colorectal, endometrial, and multiple extracolonic cancers. Advances in molecular diagnostics, particularly universal tumour testing for MMR deficiency, have transformed case identification and enabled targeted germline testing and cascade screening of relatives at risk. Despite these advances, implementation remains inconsistent, with substantial attrition across diagnostic pathways and inequities in access to care. Preventive strategies-including colonoscopic surveillance, aspirin chemoprevention, and risk-reducing surgery-are effective but require gene-specific and individualised application. Therapeutically, the immunogenic biology of MMR-deficient tumours has positioned Lynch syndrome at the forefront of precision oncology, with immune checkpoint inhibitors delivering substantial benefit and emerging vaccine strategies offering promise for cancer interception. In this Review, we provide an integrated overview of Lynch syndrome across the continuum of care, highlighting advances in biology, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment, while emphasising the crucial need to align scientific progress with equitable and effective health-system delivery.
abstract.textZh: Lynch 症候群是最常見的遺傳性癌症易感性症候群，大約每 350-450 人中就有 1 人受影響，但大多數攜帶者仍未被診斷出來，這構成了一個重大且可預防的公共衛生負擔。Lynch 症候群是由 DNA 錯配修復 (MMR) 基因的生殖系致病變異所引起，其導致大腸癌、子宮內膜癌和多種結腸外癌症的風險顯著升高且具有異質性。分子診斷的進步，特別是針對 MMR 缺陷的普遍性腫瘤檢測，改變了病例的識別方式，並實現了針對性生殖系檢測以及對有風險親屬的級聯篩查。儘管有這些進展，但實施情況仍不一致，各個診斷途徑存在顯著的流失現象，且在獲得醫療照護方面存在不平等。預防策略（包括大腸鏡監測、阿斯匹靈化學預防和降低風險的手術）是有效的，但需要針對特定基因和個人化的應用。在治療方面，MMR 缺陷型腫瘤的免疫原性生物學特徵使林奇症候群成為精準腫瘤學的前沿領域。免疫檢查點抑制劑帶來了顯著的療效，而新興的疫苗策略也為癌症阻斷提供了希望。在本篇綜述中，我們針對整個照護過程提供了關於林奇症候群的綜合概述，重點介紹了生物學、診斷、預防和治療方面的進展，同時強調了使科學進步與臨床實踐相一致的關鍵必要性。

articles.title: Treatment of Acute Ischemic Stroke: A Review
articles.authors: Albers GW, Heit JJ

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Acute ischemic stroke, caused by thrombotic or embolic occlusion of a cervical or cerebral artery, leads to neurologic injury due to sudden disruption of blood flow to the brain. Ischemic stroke is a leading cause of disability and death and accounts for about 85% of strokes in the US.
abstract.textZh: 急性缺血性中風是由頸動脈或大腦動脈的血栓性或栓塞性阻塞所引起，由於腦部血流突然中斷，導致神經損傷。缺血性中風是導致失能和死亡的主要原因，約佔美國中風病例的 85%。

abstract.label: OBSERVATIONS
abstract.text: Symptoms of acute ischemic stroke vary based on the area of the affected brain. Common presentations include sudden arm or leg weakness, aphasia or slurred speech, sudden loss of balance or coordination, sudden visual difficulties, and/or facial drooping. Patients with suspected stroke should be transported to the nearest emergency department for urgent brain imaging, typically noncontrast computed tomography (CT). Based on 2026 American Heart Association/American Stroke Association (AHA/ASA) guidelines, first-line therapy for patients with acute ischemic stroke presenting within 4.5 hours from symptom onset with disabling symptoms (eg, affecting the ability to perform activities of daily living) is intravenous thrombolysis (tenecteplase or alteplase) in those without intracranial hemorrhage or other contraindications to thrombolysis. The treatment window can be extended to 9 hours-and up to 24 hours in patients with large vessel occlusion (eg, involving the internal carotid artery or proximal middle cerebral artery [M1 segment]) who are unable to receive thrombectomy-based on identification of salvageable tissue using perfusion imaging with CT perfusion or magnetic resonance imaging. In appropriately selected patients with acute ischemic stroke, pooled randomized trial data show an approximately 10% absolute increase in the probability of a better functional outcome with intravenous thrombolysis. Based on 2026 AHA/ASA guidelines, endovascular thrombectomy, which involves clot removal with an intra-arterial mechanical device, is recommended for patients with large vessel occlusion within 6 hours of stroke onset (class 1 recommendation) and is recommended in selected patients with large vessel occlusion within 24 hours of last known well (class 1 recommendation). Endovascular therapy should be performed after intravenous thrombolysis unless patients have contraindications to thrombolytic therapy. Compared with medical management, which includes intravenous thrombolysis when indicated, endovascular thrombectomy produces an approximately 20% absolute increase in functional independence.

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Acute ischemic stroke causes substantial disability and mortality. First-line therapy for patients with disabling acute stroke symptoms is intravenous thrombolysis (if no contraindications) within 4.5 hours of stroke onset and up to 24 hours in carefully selected patients not receiving mechanical thrombectomy; for large vessel occlusions, mechanical thrombectomy may be performed up to 24 hours after stroke onset in eligible patients.

articles.title: Izalontamab Brengitecan in Recurrent or Metastatic Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma: The PANKU-Esophagus01 Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Lu Z, Huang Z, Meng X, Fan Y, Wu T, Pang Q, Wang F, Zhang Y, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Effective therapy remains lacking for patients with advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) whose disease progressed after standard treatment. Izalontamab brengitecan, an epidermal growth factor receptor and human epidermal growth factor receptor 3 bispecific antibody-drug conjugate with a topoisomerase I inhibitor, Ed-04, has shown clinical activity in ESCC in a phase 1b study.
abstract.textZh: 對於在標準治療後疾病惡化的晚期食道鱗狀細胞癌 (ESCC) 患者，仍缺乏有效的治療方法。Izalontamab brengitecan 是一種表皮生長因子受體和人類表皮生長因子受體 3 的雙特異性抗體藥物複合體，含有拓撲異構酶 I 抑制劑 Ed-04，在一項 1b 期研究中已顯示出對 ESCC 的臨床活性。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of izalontamab brengitecan compared with chemotherapy in patients with advanced ESCC who progressed after first-line programmed cell death 1 protein (PD-1)/programmed cell death 1 ligand 1 (PD-L1) inhibitor plus platinum-containing chemotherapy.
abstract.textZh: 評估在接受一線計畫性細胞死亡 1 蛋白 (PD-1)/計畫性細胞死亡 1 配體 1 (PD-L1) 抑制劑合併含鉑化療後疾病惡化的晚期 ESCC 患者中，izalontamab brengitecan 與化療相比的療效和安全性。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: This phase 3, open-label, randomized clinical trial was conducted across 80 hospitals in China. Patients with recurrent or metastatic ESCC that had progressed with first-line PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor plus platinum-containing chemotherapy were enrolled. Between March 19, 2024, and August 1, 2025 (final follow-up, October 17, 2025), a total of 704 patients were screened, and 497 were enrolled and randomized.
abstract.textZh: 這項第 3 期、開放標籤、隨機臨床試驗在中國 80 家醫院進行。收案的患者為接受一線 PD-1/PD-L1 抑制劑合併含鉑化療後仍惡化的復發性或轉移性 ESCC 患者。在 2024 年 3 月 19 日至 2025 年 8 月 1 日期間（最後一次追蹤為 2025 年 10 月 17 日），共有 704 名患者接受篩選，其中 497 名患者入組並接受隨機分組。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Patients were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive either izalontamab brengitecan (n = 249; 2.5 mg/kg on days 1 and 8 every 3 weeks) or physician-selected chemotherapy (n = 248; irinotecan, paclitaxel, or docetaxel) every 3 weeks.
abstract.textZh: 患者被隨機分配（1:1）每 3 週接受一次 izalontamab brengitecan（n = 249；第 1 天和第 8 天 2.5 mg/kg）或醫師選擇的化療（n = 248；irinotecan、paclitaxel 或 docetaxel）。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The dual primary end points were progression-free survival (PFS) assessed by blinded independent central review according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 and overall survival (OS).
abstract.textZh: 雙重主要終點是根據實體瘤療效評估標準第 1.1 版，透過盲性獨立中心審查評估的無惡化存活期 (PFS) 和整體存活期 (OS)。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of 497 patients who underwent randomization (median age, 61.0 years [range, 34-76]; 448 male patients [90.1%]), 493 received study treatment. At this interim analysis, izalontamab brengitecan demonstrated statistically significant improvement in both PFS and OS. Median PFS by blinded independent central review was 4.17 months (95% CI, 3.61-4.53 months) with izalontamab brengitecan vs 1.97 months (95% CI, 1.61-2.73 months) with chemotherapy (hazard ratio, 0.50; 95% CI, 0.40-0.63; log-rank P < .001). Median OS was 9.79 months (95% CI, 7.89-11.01 months) with izalontamab brengitecan vs 7.20 months (95% CI, 6.18-7.82 months) with chemotherapy (hazard ratio, 0.63; 95% CI, 0.48-0.82; log-rank P < .001). Grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events occurred in 212 of 249 patients (85.1%) with izalontamab brengitecan and 147 of 248 patients (59.3%) with chemotherapy and were predominantly hematologic.

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Izalontamab brengitecan significantly improved PFS and OS vs chemotherapy in patients with recurrent or metastatic ESCC whose disease had progressed after first-line treatment. These findings support izalontamab brengitecan as a new second-line treatment for this population in China.

articles.title: Intismeran Autogene plus Pembrolizumab for Resected Stage IIB to IV Melanoma
articles.authors: Long GV, Khattak MA, Gogas HJ, Schadendorf D, Arance A, Carlino MS, Rutkowski P, Rivalland G, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Intismeran autogene (intismeran) is an individualized neoantigen therapy that is designed to induce new T-cell responses and expand preexisting T-cell responses against patient-specific tumor neoantigens, which may potentially improve the efficacy of adjuvant therapy in patients with melanoma.
abstract.textZh: Intismeran autogene (intismeran) 是一種個人化新抗原療法，旨在誘導新的 T 細胞反應，並擴大針對患者特異性腫瘤新抗原的既有 T 細胞反應，這可能改善黑色素瘤患者的輔助治療療效。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this phase 3, double-blind trial, we randomly assigned patients with completely resected stage IIB to IV cutaneous melanoma in a 2:1 ratio to receive intramuscular intismeran (at a dose of 1 mg) or placebo every 3 weeks for nine doses; all the patients received intravenous pembrolizumab (at a dose of 400 mg) every 6 weeks for nine cycles. The primary end point was investigator-determined recurrence-free survival, assessed in a time-to-event analysis. Key secondary end points included investigator-determined distant-metastasis-free survival (assessed in a time-to-event analysis) and safety.
abstract.textZh: 在這項第 3 期雙盲試驗中，我們以 2:1 的比例將完全切除的 IIB 至 IV 期皮膚黑色素瘤患者隨機分配，每 3 週接受一次肌肉注射 intismeran（劑量為 1 毫克）或安慰劑，共 9 次；所有患者每 6 週接受一次靜脈注射 pembrolizumab（劑量為 400 毫克），共 9 個週期。主要終點是由試驗主持人確定的無復發生存期，透過事件發生時間分析進行評估。主要次要終點包括試驗主持人確定的無遠端轉移存活期（在事件發生時間分析中評估）和安全性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 1137 patients underwent randomization: 757 to the intismeran-pembrolizumab group and 380 to the placebo-pembrolizumab group. The median follow-up was 24.6 months. Recurrence-free survival at 24 months was 82.2% in the intismeran-pembrolizumab group and 70.0% in the placebo-pembrolizumab group (two-sided P<0.001); the piecewise hazard ratio was 0.99 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.66 to 1.49) before 6 months and 0.42 (95% CI, 0.30 to 0.58) after 6 months. Distant-metastasis-free survival at 24 months was 88.5% with intismeran-pembrolizumab and 80.2% with placebo-pembrolizumab (two-sided P = 0.002); the piecewise hazard ratio was 1.01 (95% CI, 0.58 to 1.79) before 6 months and 0.50 (95% CI, 0.34 to 0.73) after 6 months. Adverse events of grade 3 or higher occurred in 23.6% of the patients in the intismeran-pembrolizumab group and 20.3% of the patients in the placebo-pembrolizumab group. Eight patients (1.1%) in the intismeran-pembrolizumab group died from an adverse event; five of the deaths occurred before intismeran was administered.
abstract.textZh: 共有 1137 名患者接受隨機分組：757 名患者分至 intismeran-pembrolizumab 組，380 名患者分至安慰劑-pembrolizumab 組。中位數追蹤期為 24.6 個月。在 24 個月時，intismeran-pembrolizumab 組的無復發生存率為 82.2%，安慰劑-pembrolizumab 組為 70.0%（雙側 P<0.001）；分段風險比在 6 個月前為 0.99（95% 信賴區間 [CI]，0.66 至 1.49），在 6 個月後為 0.42（95% CI，0.30 至 0.58）。在 24 個月時，intismeran-pembrolizumab 組的無遠端轉移存活率為 88.5%，安慰劑-pembrolizumab 組為 80.2%（雙側 P = 0.002）；分段風險比在 6 個月前為 1.01（95% CI，0.58 至 1.79），在 6 個月後為 0.50（95% CI，0.34 至 0.73）。intismeran-pembrolizumab 組中有 23.6% 的患者發生 3 級或以上的疑似不良事件，安慰劑-pembrolizumab 組中有 20.3% 的患者發生 3 級或以上的疑似不良事件。intismeran-pembrolizumab 組有 8 名患者 (1.1%) 因不良事件死亡；其中 5 名患者在施用 intismeran 之前死亡。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Adjuvant therapy with intismeran plus pembrolizumab significantly prolonged recurrence-free survival and distant-metastasis-free survival as compared with pembrolizumab alone in patients with completely resected, high-risk cutaneous melanoma. (Funded by Merck Sharp and Dohme and Moderna; ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05933577.).
abstract.textZh: 對於完全切除的高風險皮膚黑色素瘤患者，與單用 pembrolizumab 相比，intismeran 聯合 pembrolizumab 的輔助治療顯著延長了無復發生存期和無遠端轉移生存期。（由默克雪蘭諾與莫德納贊助；ClinicalTrials.gov 編號：NCT05933577）。

articles.title: Trevogrumab (anti-GDF8) with or without garetosmab (anti-activin A) for prevention of muscle loss during semaglutide-induced weight reduction in people with obesity (COURAGE): a two-part, phase 2, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomised trial
articles.authors: Mosenzon O, Rosenstock J, Raya JG, Grimsby JS, Calle RA, Cannon K, Haggag AZ, Bays H, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Rapid weight loss, as induced by GLP-1 receptor agonists, is accompanied by pronounced muscle loss. GDF8 (myostatin) and activin A (ActA), acting via ActRIIA/B receptors, are negative regulators of muscle mass. The aim of this study was to evaluate the effect of antibodies blocking GDF8 (trevogrumab) and ActA (garetosmab) on semaglutide-induced weight and muscle loss.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: COURAGE is a two-part, phase 2, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomised trial. This multicentre (60 sites), US-based trial enrolled participants aged 18-80 years with obesity (BMI ≥30 kg/m2). In part A, participants were treated for 26 weeks with semaglutide (titrated to 2·4 mg subcutaneously weekly) in addition to a randomly assigned (1:1:1:1) concomitant treatment: placebo, trevogrumab 200 mg, trevogrumab 400 mg, or trevogrumab 400 mg and garetosmab 10 mg/kg. Trevogrumab was administered subcutaneously weekly and garetosmab was administered intravenously every 4 weeks. Part A also included a subsequent semaglutide withdrawal period, at which point participants (randomly assigned at baseline 1:1 within each group) received either trevogrumab 400 mg or placebo for an additional 26 weeks. In part B, participants were treated with semaglutide for 52 weeks and randomly assigned (1:2:2) to concomitant treatment with placebo, trevogrumab 25 mg, or trevogrumab 75 mg. Groups were stratified according to sex, BMI (<35 kg/m2vs ≥35 kg/m2), and participation in an exploratory MRI substudy assessing thigh muscle volume. Study participants, the principal investigators, and study site personnel were masked to all randomisation assignments throughout the study. Primary endpoints were percent change in lean mass, fat mass, and bodyweight from baseline to week 26 (part A) or week 52 (part B). Efficacy and safety analyses were done in all randomly assigned participants who received at least one dose of a study drug (efficacy, as randomly assigned; safety, as treated). COURAGE is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT06299098, and is currently active, not recruiting.

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: 975 participants were enrolled between June 21, 2024, and April 14, 2025. Mean age was 49·0 years (SD 13·2) and mean BMI was 36·7 kg/m2 (SD 5·0); 627 (64%) of 975 participants were female and 348 (36%) were male. In part A (n=605, of whom n=599 received at least one dose of study drug), a substantial decrease in lean mass was observed in the semaglutide plus placebo group at week 26 (-6·6% [95% CI -7·4 to -5·7]); the estimated treatment difference (ETD) versus semaglutide plus placebo was +3·1% (95% CI 1·9 to 4·3) with semaglutide plus trevogrumab 200 mg, +2·7% (1·5 to 4·0) with semaglutide plus trevogrumab 400 mg, and +4·5% (3·1 to 5·9) with semaglutide plus trevogrumab 400 mg plus garetosmab 10 mg/kg. In part B (n=376), lean mass percent change from baseline to week 52 for semaglutide plus placebo was -7·3% (-8·8 to -5·8); the ETD versus semaglutide plus placebo was +1·5% (-0·3 to 3·3) for semaglutide plus trevogrumab 25 mg, and +3·1% (1·3 to 4·9) for semaglutide plus trevogrumab 75 mg. Change from baseline in fat mass in part A was -15·6% (-17·4 to -13·9) in the semaglutide plus placebo group; the ETD was significant in the semaglutide plus trevogrumab 400 mg group (-3·4% [-5·9 to -0·9]) and the semaglutide plus trevogrumab 400 mg plus garetosmab 10 mg/kg group (-11·7% [-14·4 to -9·0]) in part A. No other groups in part A nor any in part B had significantly different changes in fat mass compared with semaglutide plus placebo. Percent change in bodyweight in part A was -10·6 (-11·6 to -9·7) in the semaglutide plus placebo group; the ETD was significant for the semaglutide plus trevogrumab 400 mg plus garetosmab 10 mg/kg group (-2·7 [-4·1 to -1·2]). No other groups in part A nor any in part B had significantly different changes in bodyweight compared with semaglutide plus placebo. Semaglutide plus trevogrumab (25 mg, 75 mg, 200 mg, or 400 mg) was generally well tolerated with a safety profile similar to semaglutide plus placebo; however, semaglutide plus trevogrumab 400 mg plus garetosmab 10 mg/kg had a high incidence of serious adverse events (14 [9%] of 149) and treatment discontinuations (48 [32%] of 149). Gastrointestinal adverse events were the most commonly reported, and they occurred with similar incidence across treatment groups. Muscle spasms occurred more frequently in the semaglutide plus trevogrumab 400 mg plus garetosmab 10 mg/kg group (61 [41%] of 149) compared with the semaglutide plus trevogrumab 200 mg or 400 mg groups (23 [8%] of 299) and semaglutide plus placebo groups (seven [5%] of 151). Most adverse events were mild to moderate in severity. Two deaths occurred during the study, both in the semaglutide plus trevogrumab 400 mg plus garetosmab 10 mg/kg group; a causal association between treatment and these events was not identified.

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: This study establishes proof of concept for GDF8 inhibition by trevogrumab alone as a generally well tolerated strategy to preserve lean mass during GLP-1 receptor agonist-induced weight loss. Although the addition of ActA inhibition by garetosmab further improved body composition and weight loss, the combination did not have favourable safety and tolerability. Further study is required to understand whether improved body composition during weight loss might preserve physical function and overall metabolic health.

articles.title: Who will I find behind the door? Perspectives of chronically ill patients after the loss of their regular general practitioner in southern Spain
articles.authors: Herrero-Rubí J, Hortal Carmona J, García Caballos M, García Rincón L, García Ors G, Roch García M, Fansa Fernández F, Salvatore Benito A, et al.

abstract.text: Background  Relational continuity is a key element of quality Primary Health Care (PHC). In the current global PCH crisis, this dimension is hampered by professional instability. Aim  To explore the consequences of professional instability for chronically ill patients without a regular general practitioner (RGP) in southern Spain and its relationship with PHC functioning and quality. Design and Setting  Qualitative study conducted in PHC settings in the province of Granada, Spain, throughout 2024. Method  26 semi-structured interviews with chronically ill patients without an RGP were conducted. The interviews were analysed using a Grounded Theory approach to capture the subjective experiences and meanings attributed to PHC. Results  Faced with frequent professional turnover, patients reported distrust, frustration, and feelings of abandonment. Being seen by a different doctor each time and repeatedly discussing their health problems with different professionals was perceived as undermining their healthcare experience. Patients recalled the value of having an RGP, describing higher-quality and more efficient care, with fewer access barriers, as well as psychological and emotional support that they could no longer find. Conclusion  Limited continuity may hinder the development of doctor-patient bonds, which participants associated with greater support, increased trust, and a more responsive PHC experience. In this context, professional instability may contribute to frustration, dissatisfaction, and reduced trust in care. These findings suggest that professional stability is important for sustaining accessible, supportive, and clinically reliable primary care for patients with chronic conditions. Keywords  General Practice; Relational Continuity of Care; Professional-Patient Relations.

articles.title: A blended digital parenting intervention for the prevention of sexual violence, exploitative sex, and maltreatment of children at scale in Tanzania: a cluster-randomised, controlled trial
articles.authors: Cluver LD, Ornellas A, Klapwijk JM, Nyalali K, Chetty AN, Mgunga S, Melendez-Torres GJ, Kahwa J, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Childhood sexual, physical, and verbal violence are global public health priorities, affecting 1 billion children each year. ParentApp integrates sexual violence prevention into WHO-UNICEF's open-access Parenting for Lifelong Health programme, using innovative blended digital delivery. We aimed to test the efficacy of ParentApp in preventing sexual violence and maltreatment against adolescent-aged children and improving preventive mechanisms such as family mental health and adolescent-caregiver relationships.

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This cluster-randomised, controlled trial was conducted in 80 Tanzanian sub-wards. Participants were primary caregivers aged 18 years and older and their adolescents (aged 10-17 years). Sub-wards were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive either ParentApp (intervention group) or a control WASHApp programme. Clusters were randomly assigned in blocks of six, stratified by urban versus rural location. Statisticians carrying out randomisation and data analysts were masked; it was not possible to mask participants or researchers. Intervention groups received a low-cost Android phone installed with ParentApp, a 12-module offline-first app, with one in-person orientation session and remote support via WhatsApp group chats, at a delivery cost of US$6 per family at scale, or $10 with 20% smartphone provision. Control groups received a low-cost Android phone installed with WASHApp, a 12-module offline-first app for water, sanitation, and hygiene, with one in-person orientation session. The primary outcomes were adolescent sexual violence victimisation and maltreatment and high-risk situations for sexual violence, assessed in all participants irrespective of uptake and engagement at 5 months and 18 months post-baseline. The trial was registered on March 14, 2023, with OSF (https://osf.io/t9fxz) and is completed.

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between May 11 and Oct 9, 2023, 2692 caregiver-adolescent dyads were screened for study eligibility; 2396 adolescents (1217 [50·8%] female and 1179 [49·2%] male) and 2396 caregivers (1795 [74·9%] female and 601 [25·1%] male) were recruited. 2145 (89·5%) adolescents and 2252 (94·0%) caregivers were retained in the study and included in analyses at 18 months. Adolescent girls in ParentApp clusters had a substantial reduction in past-month sexual violence victimisation compared with those in control clusters (incidence rate ratio [IRR] 0·43 [95% CI 0·21-0·86]; p=0·018), with no effect for boys (1·21 [0·59-2·43]; p=0·60). Past-month maltreatment (physical abuse, verbal abuse, and neglect) was lower in ParentApp clusters than in control clusters (adolescent report IRR 0·92 [0·88-0·96]; p<0·0001, caregiver report 0·87 [0·82-0·92]; p<0·0001). Past-month exposure to high-risk situations for sexual violence was lower in ParentApp clusters than in control clusters (adolescent girls IRR 0·87 [0·77-0·97]; p=0·012, adolescent boys 0·85 [0·79-0·91]; p<0·0001, caregiver report 0·81 [0·75-0·88]; p<0·0001). There were no reported adverse events.

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: A low-cost blended digital parenting programme in countries such as Tanzania could simultaneously reduce childhood sexual violence (for girls) and maltreatment and sexual violence risk situations (for girls and boys).
